$comment: 🔴 NOT A REAL PRODUCT. A fictional full-feature lock that exists ONLY so LockSim can answer Tuya 0x01 with a PID and the bench can exercise PID discovery end to end — ask, parse, match, switch profile, persist, report on info/heartbeat. Before this, none of that had ever run: LockSim did not answer 0x01 and no real Tuya MCU has been on our wire. The PID is deliberately un-Tuya-like so it can never be mistaken for a supplier value. Every DP below is selected from the REAL catalogue, so the fiction is in the PRODUCT, not in the DP numbers — a bench pass here says the discovery mechanism works, and says nothing about any shipping lock. See ozkey-37.

supplier.module: none — this is LockSim, our own MCU emulator

source.note: Operator: 'for the LOCKSIM we can makeup a PID that has keypad, rfid, doorbell, fingerprint'. Capabilities chosen to make every branch of the app's capability table reachable on the bench.

features.capabilities_note: keypad + RFID + fingerprint + doorbell, i.e. the maximal case. The app's default profile for an UNKNOWN pid is the opposite (RFID + app only), so these two together exercise both ends of its lookup.
